snippet.title: Teaser Trailer - Aperture Dating Simulator
snippet.description:
It's finally time to reveal the project I've been keeping in the dark! I present to you... Aperture Dating Simulator!

You take on the role of a manufacturing employee thrust into the entirely different realm of core maintenance. Guided by the level-headed Miss Esther, you'll meet plenty of interesting personalities during your two-week stay in this department...

APDS is a passion project lead by one individual. There's still much dialogue to write and some characters still need casting, but I'm excited to bring this project to life! Follow this channel to stay in the loop!

Song: Killshot by Magdalena Bay
Voice/Editing/Art: Ashleyanna Rivers


Aperture Dating Simulator is a Portal series fan game. This project is not conmerically associated with Valve or the Portal franchise, and all Portal material falls under the copyright of the Valve Corporation.
